findings.F1: The timeout state's canary is not a constant under the matrix's mixed load: E04 (baseline), E09 (baseline), E10 (baseline) and E29 (baseline) receipts print canary=false while every other conjunct and all 12 C1_ROW lines are identical; the corresponding mutant or restored arms print canary=true. 24 controlled reruns of the same state bytes (6 sequential, 12 concurrent, 8 pos-real + 6 timeout mixed) all printed canary=true, so this is an intermittent host-scheduling artefact of the 0.001 s timeout, not a deterministic state property. No graded conjunct moved and all 12 battery rows still matched. Receipts: E04.out, E09.out, E10.out, E29.out, F1-canary-race.out.
findings.F2: 0 of the 12 survivors is killed by the v95 battery. The five states added over round 94's 45 are four PASS presentation fixtures and one setup refusal; none names a verdict/reader rule, so a permissive single-edit removal still satisfies them. The battery's 50 states do not grade any of the twelve rules under test.
findings.F3: Three rules remain ungraded by the committed battery and by every other check: E20 (figure anchoring), E26 (coverage own-cell) and E30 (one-verdict-column). The isolation states P20/P26/P30 each pass the mutant where the pristine refuses (or the reverse), so these are state-coverage gaps (round-94 B2/B4), not subsumption and not pin invariance.
findings.F4: The committed masking defects B1-B3 still hold: position is masked by dup, width by position, and one-verdict-column by the delimiter rule. E13/E15/E16 are nevertheless genuinely subsumed (another check refuses the isolating state); E30 is only masked and the isolating state passes the mutant.

note: Classification is measured against the v95 battery's own expectations and, where the battery is blind, against purpose-built isolation states P09/P10/P13/P15/P16/P20/P26/P29/P30/P32. 'ungraded' marks a rule that no committed v95 battery state and no other check refuses; the isolation receipt shows the discriminating state missing from the battery (round-94 B2/B4 routing).
